subject: SkyTech outstanding balance — proposed phased remit & VAT evidence request
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: accounts-payable@skytechops.com, Daniel Morris <dan.morris@skytechops.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Invoice INV-86712 — 30 days overdue, request for remit timeline

Hi Daniel / AP team,

Following up — Invoice INV-86712 for Redwood Inference (period: Oct 01 — Oct 31, 2028) is showing as unpaid in our ledger. Due date was 2028-11-15 and the outstanding balance is EUR 48,760.

Could you confirm:
- Whether this is in remit queue or held for documentation?
- If held, what evidence is needed to release payment (PO, VAT certificate, amended remit instructions)?

We prefer to avoid holding services; if there are timing constraints, please propose a concrete staggered payment schedule so we can coordinate billing and avoid suspension.

Attachments: INV-86712.pdf (invoice, 1 page)

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive — EMEA
Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Morris <dan.morris@skytechops.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, accounts-payable@skytechops.com
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@skytechops.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Dec 2028 11:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-86712 — 30 days overdue, request for remit timeline

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the note. Apologies for the delay — the invoice hit our queue but is currently parked pending VAT evidence and alignment with PO #PT-9922. Finance needs a VAT registration certificate for Redwood (EU VAT ID) before they can process cross-border remit.

Proposed workaround we can do quickly:
- Immediate partial payment of 40% on Mon 04 Dec (EUR 19,504)
- Remaining 60% once VAT certificate is provided and matched to PO (target by Fri 08 Dec)

If Redwood can provide the VAT certificate and a short remit plan (bank details + beneficiary name + invoice reference mapping), I can push the partial payment through next week.

Regards,
Daniel Morris
Senior AP Specialist
SkyTech Operations Ltd.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 03 Dec 2028 08:45:00 +0100
Subject: internal: SkyTech partial remit proposal & exec ask

Ava / Laura — quick internal note. I reviewed SkyTech's ledger: customer has been a steady user but cashflows are patchy (seasonal). We should accept the partial payment rather than push to credit hold because churn risk is material.

Suggested actions:
- Offer the staged remit Daniel proposed (40% / 60%) but require VAT evidence by EOD Thu 07 Dec.
- Ben will run a 1:1 with SkyTech exec (Olivia) to confirm next invoice cadence and ask for a single-point contact for payment.
- If VAT evidence not provided by 07 Dec, we put account on billing alert and schedule an executive touch (Laura to join).

Also recommend offering a 7-day temporary grace and a one-time waived late fee as a relationship gesture if they complete remit by the target date.

Thoughts?

—Ben
Senior Director, Revenue Operations

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>

Hi Daniel — thank you, that helps.

We can do the following:
- We will upload and send the Redwood EU VAT registration certificate (attached) today.
- We accept the proposed phased remit: 40% on Mon 04 Dec and 60% on or before Fri 08 Dec once documentation is matched.
- Attached is a short remit plan (proposed-remit-plan.xlsx) with bank beneficiary, IBAN, invoice reference mapping and the PO mapping you requested.

Please confirm when the 40% posts and if AP requires any additional beneficiary paperwork for cross-border payments (we can get a bank letter if needed). If you prefer to escalate to Olivia for exec confirmation, loop her in — Ben and Laura are on copy and available.

Attachments: SkyTech-VAT-Certificate.pdf; proposed-remit-plan.xlsx

Thanks,
Ava Chen

Hi Ava — confirmed.

AP processed a 40% settlement (EUR 19,504) this morning; it should clear in your account within 2 business days. Our team received the VAT certificate and remit plan — thank you for the fast turnaround.

Olivia has asked me to confirm that SkyTech will be on the updated invoice cadence for Q1 and that Redwood will provide an annual billing contact for cross-border tax paperwork; Olivia will reach out separately to schedule a 15-minute alignment call.

We will process the remaining 60% once the PO/ERP match is complete (expected by Fri 08 Dec). I'll follow up if anything blocks that flow.

Best,
Daniel Morris
Senior AP Specialist
SkyTech Operations Ltd.
